title: Build FoodGroups Frontend App
declaredInterface: SPA with routes: / (groups home), /groups/:id (group detail), /groups/:id/food/:foodId (food item detail), /profile (user profile)
assumptions: Frontend-only build. No backend. Data persisted via localStorage. Vite + React + TypeScript stack. React Router v6 for routing. Lucide React for icons.

completion.whatWasBuilt: Full frontend SPA for FoodGroups — a social food discovery app for friend groups. Includes group management (create/join via invite code), food item cards with images and category badges, star ratings + text reviews, threaded discussion comments, like system for reviews and comments, and a profile editor. All data persists via localStorage.

decisions.why: Fast DX, strong typing, aligns with the approved plan
decisions.alternativesConsidered: Plain HTML/JS — rejected as too limiting for component reuse and state

decisions.why: Frontend-only prototype needs no backend. Zero extra dependencies. All mutations are pure spreads so swapping in a real API later is straightforward.
decisions.alternativesConsidered: Zustand — rejected to keep the bundle lean; Redux — overkill for this scope

decisions.decision: CSS Modules + global.css design system over TailwindCSS
decisions.why: Per project guidelines: vanilla CSS, maximum flexibility. Dark amber token palette centralised in global.css for easy theme changes.
decisions.alternativesConsidered: TailwindCSS — not requested by user; inline styles — poor maintainability

decisions.decision: FoodCategory as a union type, not enum
decisions.why: Union types are directly compatible with HTML select option values, avoiding any casting at the form layer.

completion.knownLimitations: No real auth — current user identity is local only. No image upload — image URLs only. No real-time updates between browser tabs (localStorage only).
completion.nextSteps: Wire up a backend (e.g. Supabase or Express) to replace the localStorage layer. Add real authentication. Add image upload support. Add push notifications for new comments.
